meta.title: agent-ic · A Telegram bot that answers from your own documents
meta.description: Build a Telegram bot for your salon, clinic, shop or service. Add your price list and FAQ, connect Telegram and go live in about 10 minutes. No code.

hero.badge: For salons, clinics, shops and services
hero.lead: Pick a template, add your price list and FAQ, connect Telegram. Your bot is live in about 10 minutes — and hands the chat to your team when it can’t help.
hero.note: No code · Ukrainian and English · a person can always step in

mock.alt: The agent-ic flow builder: a Telegram trigger, a conversation guard, a router, the Receptionist agent and Send replies, next to a Telegram chat where the bot answers from a price list
mock.knowledgeNote: Knowledge bases are attached to an agent in its settings, not placed on the canvas.

chat.name: Demo salon
chat.question: How long does a gel manicure take?
chat.answer: About 75 minutes, including removing the old coating.
chat.offer: Want me to find a time for you?

how.title: From sign-up to a live bot in three steps
how.lead: The quick-start walks you through it. You can change everything later in the flow builder.

template.title: Pick a template
template.text: FAQ, FAQ with hand-off, scheduled follow-up or event notifications. Or start from scratch.

documents.title: Add your documents
documents.text: Upload PDFs and docs, or connect Google Docs and Notion. The bot answers only from them.

publish.title: Connect Telegram and publish
publish.text: Paste your bot token from @BotFather. Or use the API channel for your website or CRM.

features.title: Everything a small team needs to run a bot

flow.title: Visual flow builder
flow.text: Drag steps onto a canvas: agents, conditions, messages, API requests. No code.

knowledge.title: Answers from your documents
knowledge.text: Knowledge bases from files, Google Docs and Notion, kept in sync.

inbox.title: Inbox for your team
inbox.text: Take over any chat, reply yourself, then hand it back to the bot.

testing.title: Test before customers see it
testing.text: A simulator runs your draft. Customers keep talking to the live version.

versions.title: Versions and rollback
versions.text: Every publish is a version. Restore an old one in two clicks.

api.title: API for your site or CRM
api.text: Send messages and events from your own systems; get replies by webhook.

cta.title: Your first bot is about 10 minutes away
cta.text: Start with a template and your own documents.
